addRdpHint: Computers with remote desktop (RDP) turned on
addVncHint: Linux, Raspberry Pi and other computers that share their screen
empty: Add a computer to connect to its screen from here.
emptyFav: Mark a computer with the star to see it here.
removeDetail: Its picture is deleted too. Saved credentials stay in Remote Desk Settings.
hostHint: Name or IP address, e.g. 192.168.1.20 or pc.local
hostBad: Use a name or an IP address, optionally followed by :port.
hostPort: Add :port only if it isn't the usual {port}.
name: Friendly name
reconnect: Reconnect if the connection is dropped
vncPlain: It is not encrypted: anyone on the network can see this session. Use it only on a network you trust.
scaleHint: Makes text and controls on the remote desktop bigger.
vncSize: A VNC session keeps the size of the remote screen and is fitted to the window.
devicesIntro: What the remote computer can use from here:
foldersIntro: The remote computer sees these folders of yours as drives. Read-only folders can't be changed from there.
folderBad: Choose a folder inside your home that isn't hidden.
passwordKeep: Leave empty to keep the saved one
domainWhy: Only computers joined to a company network (a directory domain) need it. For a home PC, leave it empty.
userBad: Use letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores, or a full sign-in name (name@example.com).
credsSafe: The password is kept in your keyring, never in settings.
cert: First connection to this computer. Its certificate is {print}. Trust it?
certChanged: This server's certificate CHANGED. It may be a different server. Before: {old}. Now: {print}
vncPwHint: Leave it empty if this computer doesn't ask for a password.
err.denied: That user name or password was not accepted.
err.failed: The connection could not be made.
err.unreachable: That computer does not answer. Check that it is on and accepts remote connections.
err.notfound: Couldn't find “{host}” on the network. Check the name or use its IP address.
err.gone: This computer is no longer saved.
pictures: Keep a picture of each computer
picturesHint: Taken a few seconds after each connection and kept only on this computer, readable only by you.
credsIntro: The user names you sign in with. Pick one for each computer in its Credentials menu.
credsEmpty: No saved credentials. Add one with +.
groupsIntro: Groups sort the computers into sections.
credVnc: For a VNC computer only the password is used.
importBad: That file has no computer address to import.
resIntro: Sizes to offer in each computer's Display tab, besides Automatic.
reconnectDefault: New computers reconnect if the connection is dropped
